description: Handles identity verification, password recovery, secure roles, and user inactivity session monitoring.
Handles real-time item collection, validation, custom laundry/product dynamic choice modifiers, discounts, and order push transactions.
Responsible for managing cash register states (Open/Closed) and creating cash inflows or outflows directly inside the workspace view.
Manages catalog workflows including product generation wizards, multi-layered configurations, variations, images uploading, and category classification updates.
Normalizes incoming cross-domain entities into specific schemas, building layouts to stream live templates to multi-format native printing runtimes or external channels like SMS or WhatsApp.
Provides data tables, deep filter grids, pagination mechanisms, and real-time visualization over daily sales metrics and system balance charts.

moduleName: P2P Lending Core (Loans, Offers, Proposals, Chat)
description: Peer-to-peer lending marketplace: lenders publish loan offers, borrowers submit proposals, a chat thread negotiates terms, and acceptance triggers real money movement via Stripe (see stripe_payments module). Also shows each client's wallet balance (available / reserved / disbursed / repaid) and on-demand withdrawal to bank.

moduleName: Stripe Connect Onboarding & Automated Card Payments
description: Two distinct Stripe flows collected in the client onboarding wizard: (1) StripeAccountOnboarding embeds a Stripe Express Connect account-onboarding session in-app (no hosted-URL redirect) to capture payout bank details; (2) SavedCardSetup uses a Stripe SetupIntent + Elements to save a card for automated repayment collection. Both are distinct from each other — one receives money, the other is charged.

moduleName: KYC Wizard: Face Liveness, Document Capture, Presence & Signature
description: Client-side biometric verification pipeline used by both the staff-run ClientsPage wizard and the client-facing ClientFaceRecognitionPage: guided document capture with real-time distance hints, a 4-direction face-liveness challenge (blink + left/right/up/down) run entirely via @vladmandic/face-api (no Azure Face API), geolocated presence capture, and signature-crop matching against the ID's signature.

Gates app resume/launch and sensitive in-app actions (payment submission, verification start) behind the device's native biometric prompt (Face ID / fingerprint) via a Capacitor plugin. Mounted above the router so it intercepts navigation before any route renders. Toggleable per-user from Setting.tsx ('Seguridad').
